function: Parametric near-field holographic MIMO channel estimation: estimates the user position with an NN-assisted hybrid channel model and UAMP message passing, then reconstructs the channel (p. 2, 4).
system: Holographic MIMO, user-to-BS pilots: 5x5-patch user surface, 10x10-patch tri-polarized BS surface, near field, 3 GHz; fully digital and hybrid receivers; no RIS (p. 2, 8, 9).
method: Single-hidden-layer NN (50 tansig nodes) trained offline, supervised by backpropagation on channel-model samples, embedded in UAMP Bayesian message passing (NNHMP) for parametric estimation (p. 4, 5, 8).
data_channel: Dyadic Green's function channel model (eq. 5): NN training samples from numerical evaluation; simulated user position x,y in [-1,1] m, z in [20,40] m (p. 5, 10).
test_conditions: NN trained offline on channel-model samples (range not stated); tests sweep SNR, pilot length, BS patches, RF chains over random user positions; no unseen scenario (p. 5, 9-11).
baselines: Classical: LS. Own variant AppMod (NN-assisted hybrid model of the approximate channel model [4]); bounds with known user position and CRLB. No earlier learned method (p. 10).
metrics: NMSE of the channel (NMSE_H) and NMSE of the user location (NMSE_p) versus SNR, pilot length L, BS patches M, and RF chains P (p. 10).
complexity: Orders only: UAMP part O(MNL); NN node O(MN Nh^2) with Nh=50 hidden nodes; location part O(MN); no runtime or FLOPs reported (p. 5, 8).
openness: none (no code or data link in the paper)
q1_support: p. 3: "is given by the dyadic Green’s function theorem"; own analytical channel model, not 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data
q2_support: p. 5: "with the original model (5) sufficient training samples can be easily obtained using numerical methods"; tests on p. 9-11 only sweep SNR, L, M and P, and no unseen scenario, band or dataset is reported
q3_support: p. 10: "To the best of our knowledge, there are no existing works on parametric HMIMO channel estimation in the literature"; baselines are LS and AppMod, an own variant of the proposed method
q4_support: p. 8: "The UAMP part is dominated by matrix multiplication with a complexity of O(M N L)"
q5_support: p. 5: "with the original model (5) sufficient training samples can be easily obtained using numerical methods"; self-generated data from the paper's own model, and no code or data link anywhere in the paper
notes: Version read: arXiv v1 preprint (29 Aug 2024), 12 pages. Borderline for no_learning: the learned part is a one-hidden-layer NN trained offline as a surrogate of the dyadic Green channel (p. 4-5), plugged into UAMP message passing; kept as included because the trained NN is integral to the estimator. HMIMO surfaces are the transceiver arrays, not a RIS. User location is a by-product, so area 2, not 5. The NN depends only on relative patch coordinates, so the M, L, P sweeps do not change the trained model, but the paper never states a train/test difference in conditions (q2 = 0).
